title: Be The One
verse: And a son was also born to Seth, whom he named Enosh. At that time people began to worship the Lord.
observation: It appears as though humanity started going down a bad path. People began to grow more distant from God. There is a great conversation to be had about why and how important it is for us to teach the next generation to follow the Lord. However, at some point, someone has to be the one to start moving in the right direction. This does not mean you have to be a “world changer,” a “trendsetter,” or a “once-in-a-generation” type person. That’s a lot of pressure. All you need to do is decide that you want to follow the Lord. It does not matter what others are doing. It doesn’t matter if you are the only one. Someone has to be the first in your family or friend group to follow the Lord. Seth decided to change things. He had a son named Enosh, and they began to worship the Lord by name. Will you be the one, too?
application: Don’t be ashamed to follow the Lord today. Someone has to be the first.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the opportunity to follow You.
